description: Activate when: user says 'is this AI project worth doing?', 'calculate the ROI of AI', 'how long until this agent pays back?', 'build the AI business case for my boss/investors', 'what does this AI tool really cost us?', or is about to pay for an AI tool/agent or replace a manual workflow with one. Do NOT activate when: exploratory personal use with negligible cost; the system is already live and only needs an operating review (use agent-ops-monitoring); the pilot is funded and the question is how to run it to a scale/kill verdict (use ai-pilot-to-scale); the question is general CAC/LTV unit economics, not an AI project (use unit-economics-cac-ltv-payback). More: deciqai.com/c/ai-roi-business-case

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
